sections.heading: State Snapshot
sections.body: This page summarizes the current published record count, records added recently, source data freshness, and any known exclusions or coverage limits for [State Name].

sections.heading: Recent Verified Records
sections.body: Review the newest published records for this state, with API numbers or source IDs, plugging dates, and links to the source record. If the source has revised a record, CAPIT keeps and shows each revision.

sections.heading: Source Agency and Definition
sections.body: In [State Name], CAPIT follows the source agency's published definition and status language for the records on this page. Where CAPIT maps that language to a sitewide label, both the original source term and the CAPIT label stay visible.

sections.heading: Caveat
sections.body: State numbers are not always directly comparable. Definitions, publication practices, and update schedules differ across agencies. A plugged-well record confirms that plugging was recorded; it does not by itself confirm that surface restoration is complete.
